data.name: Ly
data.gender_notes: Ly is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'lye', which means 'light'. This name has been associated with various Greek goddesses, particularly Aphrodite, the goddess of love and beauty, and Lyre, the goddess of music. In Christian tradition, Ly is a symbol of enlightenment and divine inspiration. The name Ly carries the meaning “Light, Lyre, Lofty” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ly usually hope their child will grow to embody light, lyre, lofty and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Additionally, Ly was also a name of a mythological harp, an instrument of divine inspiration and musical creation. This musical connection is still celebrated in contemporary Western culture, with numerous references to the name Lyre or Ly in various forms of music and art.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, Ly symbolizes the divine enlightenment and inspiration received through faith in God. The name is derived from the Greek word 'lye' meaning 'light'. As Christ is often referred to as the light of the world, Ly represents a constant reminder of the illumination and guidance that comes from following the teachings of Jesus. The name also has a biblical connection, as Ly is the name of a swan-keeper in the story of Saint Lyre, who became a patron saint of musical education. Ly serves as a spiritual reminder to seek knowledge and inspiration from the divine, allowing us to live a more illuminated and joyful life.
